capabilities.notes: Primary-key equality; exact registration-number lookup is separate.
Registration-keyed candidates are production-backfilled and accepted under US_REGISTRATION_CANDIDATE_LOOKUP_READY_V1, then verified against serial-keyed current facts before serving.
No canonical CN domestic registration lookup field is frozen yet.
Only canonical exact-name paging is frozen; contains/fuzzy search is not implied.
Cursor position follows the complete lookup sort key and remains query/snapshot bound.

Exact normalized attorney-name facts are production-backfilled and accepted under US_ATTORNEY_NAME_LOOKUP_READY_V1; runtime revalidates candidates against current official correspondent facts and no fuzzy identity resolution is implied.

Direct official TTAB party-correspondent observations are linked to the same party's TTAB trademark properties in an exact-name-first bounded read model. The model excludes TTAB interlocutory/staff attorneys and does not claim cross-source identity or continuing representation. Production READY and benchmark acceptance are tracked by #788.
Exact normalized Agent-name facts are production-backfilled under READY_V1; no fuzzy identity resolution is implied.
US applicant candidate projection is ordered by candidate key.
Cursor position follows candidate_key, serial_number, owner_key.
Entity/role/application summary is production-backfilled under CN_ENTITY_TRADEMARK_PORTFOLIO_READY_V1.
OWNER/CO_OWNER/AGENT former relationships are served from the production-accepted entity-keyed READY_V1 summary.

A revalidated current Applicant candidate can navigate to production-accepted exact normalized-name Assignment/TTAB relationship history. The bridge is candidate-first discovery only: review is required and no cross-source identity, historical ownership, representation, legal-title, or substantive-rights conclusion is created.
Current case sort keys are application/serial numbers.
No list projection is ordered for status/class plus cursor identity.

The serial-keyed official USPTO event read model is production-accepted under US_EVENT_SERIAL_LOOKUP_READY_V1 with complete governed source coverage and bounded indexed lookup. Events are objective official facts and are not a legal-status or substantive-rights conclusion.
OWNER/CO_OWNER/AGENT observation history is production-accepted under CN_RELATIONSHIP_TIMELINE_READY_V2 and deterministically derives current/former edges.
Serial-keyed Assignment and TTAB facts map to direct official historical edges without inferring current ownership, proceeding outcome, or substantive rights.
Exact current families are mostly identity-keyed; event expansion is not.
Resolve at most 500 reel/frame candidates through the serial-keyed property facts, then read latest state only for those identities; fail closed above the ceiling.
Resolve at most 500 proceeding candidates through the serial-keyed property facts, then read latest state only for those identities; fail closed above the ceiling.
